thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: billing-usage-display-lag detected. Metric ingestion backlog / UI usage numbers stale for a subset of customers. Root TS 1862509999. Pager -> @sam (oncall-sre)

sam (oncall-sre): I’m on it. Quick scope: how many tenants, which UI surfaces, any invoice generation issues yet?

leah (billing-eng): Observed: metering-aggregation queue on cluster 'agg-eu-prod' has a 45m backlog after a small spike at 03:12 UTC. Affected surfaces: billing dashboard usage graphs and the per-tenant 'last 24h' numbers. Embeddings/emb jobs still collecting but the cached UI layer (varnish) is serving stale snapshots. No invoices generated yet — invoicing pipeline runs once/hr and it hasn’t hit the affected batch window yet.

raj (payments): Not seeing payment failures. This looks read/display-only so far. If invoices run with stale numbers, we may need to pause invoice run for the next window until fix.

sam (oncall-sre): Priority = P1 for customer-visible numbers. Action list: 1) Mitigate UI (purge cache + serve live data where safe) 2) Drain backlog on agg nodes 3) Prevent invoice run until reconciliation confirmed. @leah can you confirm # of tenants impacted?

leah (billing-eng): ~320 tenants show >5% delta vs expected for last hour. Root cause preliminary: a retention policy change in the collector caused a transient consumer offset skip, new message format variant triggered an error path so a subset of messages were NACKed and requeued causing the backlog. We pushed a hotfix (parser tolerate-v2) to agg workers at 04:05 UTC but it only partially recovered due to existing queue depth.

maria (oncall-night): I can take handoff in 40m. If we need hands-on for longer, I’ll be available.

sam (oncall-sre): Okay handoff plan: I’ll keep the thread active for the next 30m then formally hand to @maria. Please post status updates for any customer comms drafts.

leah (billing-eng): Mitigation steps running now: 1) increase agg worker replicas to 6 (was 3) 2) run targeted reprocess for NACKed partition ranges 3) purge varnish for tenants with deltas >15% (so we don't show obviously wrong numbers). Commands: ```kubectl -n billing scale deployment/agg-worker --replicas=6```
Reprocess tool: ```/opt/tools/reprocess --topic=metering --partitions=12-24 --from-offset=oldest```

sam (oncall-sre): Good. Also block the invoice cron: ```kubectl -n billing patch cronjob invoicer -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'``` — do that now and confirm.

leah (billing-eng): Done, invoice cron suspended. Verified with `kubectl get cronjob invoicer -o yaml` shows suspend: true.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: autoscaling action triggered for agg-worker, new pods coming up (events attached).

maria (oncall-night): I see replica pods initializing. ETA to drain backlog estimated 25-35m at current throughput after scale-up.

hana (support): Drafting a support note for affected customers — short + transparent. Will share here for review.

evan (customer-success): Heads up — we have a few enterprise customers likely to notice dashboard dropdown numbers. I’ll want a customer-facing blurb we can send via email/CS channels. Keep it minimal.

leah (billing-eng): Quick status page draft (please copy/edit):
```
Status: Partial degradation of billing usage metrics
Impact: A subset of customers may see delayed or stale usage numbers in the billing dashboard. Invoice generation has been paused to prevent incorrect billing.
Current status: Engineers scaled aggregation workers and are reprocessing backlog. Cache purges in progress for tenants with large deltas. ETA for visible correction: 30-60 minutes. We will post updates here.
Mitigation: Invoice runs suspended; automated reconciliation will run after backlog processed; no payments were processed with stale data.
```

sam (oncall-sre): That reads well. Make it the public status page message once we confirm the cache purge starts showing corrected numbers. Add a timestamp and link to this thread for internal details.

hana (support): Customer-facing snippet (two-line):
```
We're investigating an issue causing delayed usage numbers in the billing dashboard for some customers. We've paused invoice runs and are reprocessing usage data — we expect corrected numbers to appear within 1 hour. We'll update you as soon as we have confirmation.
```

evan (customer-success): Good. Add: If you'd like an export of raw usage for reconciliation, reply and we can provide a CSV.

raj (payments): Please also mark accounts with manual hold flag so automated collections don't trigger once invoices resume. I can run a script to set hold=true for impacted tenants once we surface the list.

leah (billing-eng): Generating impacted tenant list now: `SELECT tenant_id FROM metering.audit WHERE processed_at IS NULL AND event_time > now() - interval '2 hours'` — will post the list to secure vault/channel.

sam (oncall-sre): Good. Operational checklist for this thread: 
- [ ] Confirm backlog drained (maria)
- [ ] Observe corrected UI numbers for a sample of 50 tenants (leah)
- [ ] Unset invoice cron only after reconciliation script passes (sam + raj)
- [ ] Customer notif & status page update (hana/evan)

incident-bot: :information_source: Update: backlog processing at 40% (1862511600).

maria (oncall-night): Backlog at 72% now. Varnish cache purge shows several tenants with corrected last-24h numbers in spot checks.

leah (billing-eng): Reconciliation job queued; running on sample window. Initial diffs look under 3% for majority after reprocess. Posting reconciliation summary to internal folder in 10m.

sam (oncall-sre): If diffs remain <5% we can consider resuming invoices with a manual review. Raj — be ready to re-run collections guard script.

raj (payments): Standby. I’ll prep the hold script and a rollback plan for immediate suspend if anything looks off post-resume.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: backlog complete (1862513200).

leah (billing-eng): Verified: backlog drained. Reconciliation job results: 312 tenants processed, median delta 1.8%, max delta 9.7 (these will need manual audit). Generating CSV of tenants with >5% to hand to CS & sales.

hana (support): Posting status page now with the drafted text and a note that invoices remain paused until manual audit completes.

evan (customer-success): Sending targeted note to impacted enterprise accounts with offer for reconciliation export. Using the snippet above + link to request CSV.

sam (oncall-sre): Handing to @maria for overnight watch and postmortem prep. Maria: capture timeline and assign follow-ups: parser tolerant-v2 unit tests, add consumer-offset monitoring alert (delta > 5% in last 1h), add invoice-run preflight check to ensure no stale data.

maria (oncall-night): Handoff ack. I’ll collect logs, timeline, and own the postmortem. Tentative follow-ups assigned: leah to lead code fix/tests, raj to implement invoice preflight guard, support/CS to finalize customer comms. I’ll open a GH issue and link it here.

sam (oncall-sre): Thank you team. Final notes: incident severity = P1 -> mitigated; invoices paused and will only resume after manual audit. Postmortem target: 3-day draft.

maria (oncall-night): Closing this active pager. Will update thread with postmortem link when created. :thumbsup:
